title: api: schema versioning - deprecations, beta headers, and backward-compat shims for OpenAI compat
author: Anjali Rao
description: Motivation: We need a predictable, safe migration path for upcoming API schema changes tied to structured output, tool/function-calling semantics, and OpenAI-compat surface changes. This PR introduces explicit schema versioning (server-side and wire-level), deprecation warnings for legacy fields, an opt-in beta header for the v2 schema, and a set of backward-compatibility shims in the OpenAI compatibility layer to avoid breaking existing clients. Changes include: 1) wire contract: introduce X-Redwood-API-Version and X-Redwood-Beta headers, and a response header X-Deprecation-Warning when deprecated fields are used; 2) server behavior: runtime toggles to enable/disable strict schema enforcement per-tenant; 3) compat layer: mapping old OpenAI-style response keys (choices->outputs, finish_reason mappings, function_call shape) to the new canonical schema, with well-scoped translation logic and tests; 4) deprecation policy: server logs and admin UI notices for tenants using deprecated fields for >30 days; 5) docs: updated API reference and migration guide. Implementation notes: most work is in the api/gateway, api/compat/openai_adapter, runtime/schema, and docs. This PR is intentionally additive: new schema is opt-in via X-Redwood-Beta: api_schema_v2 or via Accept-Version semantics; default behavior preserves v1 contract except for the addition of deprecation headers. Backcompat shims are implemented as a middleware layer that runs only when the beta header is not present. The PR includes unit + integration tests covering streaming responses, function/tool calling flows, and structured-output parsing. Checklist: - [x] Add header handling and version parsing - [x] Implement translation shims in openai_adapter - [x] Add deprecation header and logging hooks - [x] Add tenant-level feature flagging - [x] Add tests (unit + integration) - [x] Update docs and migration guide - [x] Run load tests to validate streaming stability under the new middleware

release_notes: Introduces opt-in API schema v2 via X-Redwood-Beta: api_schema_v2 or Accept-Version semantics. Adds response X-Deprecation-Warning for deprecated fields and backward-compatibility shims in the OpenAI compatibility adapter. Default behavior remains v1; tenants must opt-in. Migration guide added to docs/api/migration_v2.md. This change improves structured output consistency, function/tool calling stability, and paves the way for future typed responses.
